hero.body: Leveraging AI to reduce administrative burden so clinicians can focus on what matters most: patient care.

features.headline: Built for the full nursing operations cycle
features.body: From scheduling and handover to announcements, risk monitoring, and learning, every module shares one workflow and one source of truth.
features.item0Desc: Plan, refine, and finalize schedules with coverage checks, workload balancing, and shift-rule controls.
features.item1Desc: Capture day and night handovers in a consistent format so teams can transfer care quickly and clearly.
features.item2Desc: Publish operational announcements while tracking team activity, burnout risk, and learning progress to support safer decisions at the unit level.

solutions.headline: Available Tools
solutions.body: Explore every module currently live in Chronofy.
solutions.schedulerDesc: Run OCR imports, optimize coverage, and rebalance assignments before finalizing.
solutions.nursesDesc: Maintain staff profiles, certifications, employment types, and shift preferences.
solutions.handoverDesc: Create, review, and complete bedside handover reports with structured patient data.
solutions.schedulesDesc: Review draft/finalized schedules, revisit periods, and track roster history.
solutions.ambientDesc: Capture spoken clinical notes, review AI-processed drafts, and commit updates.
solutions.burnoutDesc: Monitor risk indicators, run assessments, and manage active burnout alerts.
solutions.learningDesc: Assign modules, track completion, and monitor onboarding or competency progress.
solutions.activitiesDesc: Publish unit updates, policy changes, and urgent notices so every nurse receives the same operational message.

about.headline: Why we're building this
about.para1: Nurses spend significant time on administrative tasks that could be streamlined with better software. Paper-based workflows, redundant data entry, and manual processes take time away from patient care.
about.para2: We're working directly with clinical staff to understand their workflows and build tools that actually fit how they work, not the other way around.

trust.headline: Trust & Compliance (Medical Context)
trust.body: Controls expected for healthcare-grade scheduling tools.
trust.item0Detail: Business Associate Agreement available for healthcare organizations handling PHI.
trust.item1Detail: Data protection at rest with strong encryption standards, plus TLS in transit.
trust.item2Detail: Administrative access logs for who accessed data, what changed, and when.
trust.item3Detail: Reliability-focused operations and support readiness for clinical workflows.
